description: Server-side template injection in Elixir template engines (EEx, Phoenix HEEx). New parent (2026-07): no existing SSTI parent covers Elixir. Error-oracle extraction per PortSwigger Top-10-2025 #1 (Successful Errors). Use against Phoenix apps rendering user input through EEx.

eex_arithmetic.description: EEx evaluates <%= %> expressions server-side. Arithmetic marker 1337=1336+1 confirms evaluation.

probes.description: EEx arithmetic echo — 1337 in the response proves SSTI.

error_based_blind.description: Force an EEx/Phoenix compile or runtime error whose message echoes evaluated output; blind extraction where no reflection exists.

probes.description: Error after evaluation; 1337 echoed in the CompileError/ArgumentError body.

boolean_error_blind.description: Boolean-error oracle for Elixir: raise iff an evaluated condition holds.
